wins.claim: KerfDesk is the only roster product that models circular stock (rect + circle board capture, ADR-126, respected by fit/array); every competitor is rectangular-workspace-only. Caveat: circle layout uses only the inscribed square and no product does custom-outline/offcut stock.

KerfDesk has a genuine board-aware auto-fill (rotation-safe fit-to-board + auto-count fill-the-board); XCS, Easel and LaserGRBL have no auto-fit engine at all (XCS batch swaps content but never auto-packs).

KerfDesk ships a real production grid array (rows x cols or fit-as-many, mm spacing, double-burn-guarded); LaserGRBL has no array/replication and needs Inkscape, Easel relies on a community app (+2 vs Easel).

gaps.claim: No variable text, serial numbers, CSV/data-merge, or barcode/QR anywhere in KerfDesk (grep + ADR-confirmed); the whole paid/consumer field personalizes copies and even consumer XCS beats us 7-0. P1.
No true/irregular-shape nesting; only rectangular-cell grid tiling exists (explicitly deferred, ADR-125). Ties MillMage/XCS/Easel/LaserGRBL at 0, so shared-absence tempers severity to P2.
Array is production-time, board-bound and single-design; no circular/radial array, copy-along-path, or free-canvas design-time step-and-repeat (also -4 vs MillMage/VCarve). P2.
Fill-the-board handles identical copies of one design only; no multi-part bounding-box packing or cross-part stock optimization (also -3 vs LightBurn/MillMage). P2.
No recent-files list, saved-job/cut-settings preset, or re-run-last-job command; repeat means manually reopening a .lf2 project (also -1 vs LightBurn/MillMage/XCS). P3.

notVerified: No fidelity (SS5.3) and no hardware (SS5.4 [HW]) categories exist in S15; every score is a plain capability rating with no PERC cap and no '*' design-intent stars.

15.1/15.2 board array and fit/fill were NOT perceptually rendered or run in the live app this audit; ADR-125 states the tiled/fitted sheet was never eyeballed at authoring -- green tests assert geometry (counts, centering, guards, inscribed-square) only, not that the sheet looks right.

15.4 CNC tiling physical re-indexing (registration-hole/dowel accuracy when stock is slid and re-zeroed between tiles) is a hardware behavior -- CLAIMED, never machine-verified; the circle-stock win rests on code + ADR-126, not a live board capture; no custom-polygon or offcut stock exists to test.

15.5/15.3 absence confirmed by repo-wide grep + ADR-125; nothing to verify. (MEMORY: a 'variable text' feature appeared in Codex PR #58 but was flagged out-of-scope and is NOT on the pinned/merged tree.)
15.6 Design Library, Box Generator, and the .lf2 repeat-job round-trip (whether every cut setting survives re-open) were code-derived, not exercised live this audit.

All competitor cells are documentary ([OFF]/[COMM]); no [HANDS] runs. MillMage rated at stable 0.8.02 -- its 0.9 early-access Pro features (True Nest, serialized Variable Text, Multi-Page) are documented but not scored as shipping. VCarve leads (nesting/Plate-Production/Templates) are Pro-tier; Desktop lacks them. No win/lose bullet rests on an [INF] cell.
U cells: none in this sector.
